title: Evidence Schema
description: Support for an assertion. EVIDENCE is contextual (Vol 1 §11): source, method, and collected (freshness) are required - 'status: healthy' alone is insufficient. EVIDENCE != AUTHORITY (Vol 1 §12): evidence answers 'what happened', not 'who may act', so it holds ONLY an agent-writable status. Enforced by TOOLS/lore_validate.py Check 4 (DECISION-ONTOLOGY-ENFORCEABILITY-001).

status.description: MUST be agent-writable (EVIDENCE != AUTHORITY). Mirrors registry agent_writable.

source.description: Where the evidence came from (system, person, external authority).

method.description: How it was collected (automated_check, attestation, measurement, review...).

collected.description: When it was collected - freshness input for trust decay (Vol 2 §8).

supports.description: object-ref id(s) of the assertion(s) this evidence supports.
